newsitem.title: USA: General Growth acquires Chicago building.
newsitem.headline: General Growth acquires Chicago building.

text.p: General Growth Properties Inc, a real estate investment trust that owns and manages shopping centers, said Monday it has acquired a 220,000-square-foot office building in downtown Chicago, which the company will use as its headquarters.
Financial terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

Including all acquisition, rehabilitation, leasing and tenant improvement expenditures, General Growth expects to have about $110 per square foot invested when the renovation is complete and the building is fully occupied in 1998, the company said.
General Growth said it plans to completely upgrade and retrofit the entire building in order to create "like- new" Class A office space.
General Growth shares were unchanged at 33 Monday.
